messages:
rachel: propose lightweight header X-Route-Intent for client hints (p=priority;pool=id). aim: better routing visibility in console + optional quota attribution. thoughts?
tyler: wire format pls. JSON in header = meh. compact key=val; semicolon seems fine.
anu: agree compact. py-sdk can expose typed RouteIntent object and encoder util. no breaking change if opt-in.
mike: telemetry: ingestion should capture header as raw string initially and sample-parse later. avoid schema changes.
rachel: rollout idea: 1) add header reader + telemetry capture; 2) SDKs add opt-in emitters; 3) opt-in tenant flag for attribution; 4) wider flip.
tyler: semver plan: add types in minor release, emit header in patch? better: add API in patch, emit in minor to be safe.
rachel: good call. anu, can you draft py PR with tests for encoder and escaping?
anu: yep. will include tests for pools with hyphens and colon chars.
ingest-bot: ingest-status: edge-proxy ok, telemetry-ingest lagging (backfill required).
mike: i'll add console mock tile: "Requested Intent | Applied Pool | Quota Charged" and sampling toggle.
rachel: sweet. will post spec doc after this. closing for now. :thumbsup:
